messages:
elaine: rolling out snapshot v2026-03-17a to canary now — ETA 5m. please run quick smoke and flag anything weird. I'll watch infra dashboard (link: https://dash.redwood/serving/canary).
dev-deploy-bot: deploy started by elaine — canary nodes: 4, version: v2026-03-17a, rollout: 10% -> 100% staged.
sanjay: on it. will run basic health + sample prompts against the canary.
mike: quick heads-up: watch tokenization latency for long inputs (batch_size change in this release).
tara: re: smoke checklist — I'll validate: 1) /health 2) sanity prompts 3) p95 latency vs baseline chart 4) error rate alert thresholds.
elaine: thanks. tagging @sanjay and @tara for hotspots, @mike on batch behavior.
sanjay: /health OK from all canary nodes: 200, uptime healthy. ran sample prompt set (10 queries) -> outputs look correct. no obvious hallucination regressions.
sanjay: metrics quick snapshot: p50=45ms, p95=220ms (baseline p95=210ms), errors=0.12% (baseline 0.1%). small p95 bump, monitoring.
mike: that aligns with what I saw in staging — batch_size default got nudged to 8 for perf; increases tail for long sequences. I can push a config tweak to cap batch_size=4 for canary to test. want me to flip?
tara: yes please cap to 4 and see delta. also running a small rerank job to ensure embeddings stable.
mike: doing config change now:
```
kubectl set env deployment/serving-canary BATCH_CAP=4 --namespace=prod-canary
```
applied.
dev-deploy-bot: config change detected for deployment/serving-canary by mike.
sanjay: re-run smoke prompts after cap change.
sanjay: new metrics: p50=43ms, p95=180ms, errors=0.09%. p95 dropped under baseline. good signal.
tara: rerank outputs validated against baseline testset — no regressions.
elaine: excellent. plan: continue canary for 15 more minutes, then promote to full if no alerts. rollback plan: flip rollout back via deploy console and revert BATCH_CAP to previous if needed; full rollback checklist in runbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/deploy-rollback.
mike: FYI I left a hotpatch snippet in the deploy PR to force BATCH_CAP override if needed.
sanjay: monitoring dashboards bookmarked, alerts pinned. I'll take first 10m of watch.
tara: I'll keep an eye on cost/throughput panel and sampling.
elaine: thanks all — if no objections at +15m we promote. please react :thumbsup: when you confirm you're good.
mike: :thumbsup:
sanjay: :thumbsup:
tara: :thumbsup:
dev-deploy-bot: canary successful at 1769123600 — promoting to 100% per rollout policy.
elaine: promoted to 100%. doing quick post-promote sanity scan.
sanjay: post-promote checks: p95=185ms, errors=0.11%, throughput stable. looks good.
tara: samples fine. no regressions.
mike: keeping hotpatch ready but not needed.
elaine: closing thread after 15m of stable metrics. thanks for the fast turnaround. I'll file a short postmortem note with the batch_size observation so we don't surprise on future releases.
elaine: (closing)
